user.title: Heating prices
user.description: Prices come from open data: the EU Weekly Oil Bulletin (heating oil and LPG, weekly), the Deutsches Pelletinstitut (wood pellets, monthly, Germany only) and Eurostat (natural gas).

data_description.country: Prices are national averages including all taxes.
data_description.fuels: You can add the integration again for another country. LPG is the official price of LPG as a motor fuel (Autogas). LPG for heating is taxed differently and can cost more or less, so it is not part of the cost comparison.

pellets.title: Wood pellets
pellets.description: Average price per tonne of ENplus A1 pellets, delivered loose within 50 km, all costs and VAT included.

data_description.pellet_region: North/East: BE, BB, HB, HH, MV, NI, SH. Central: HE, NW, RP, SN, ST, TH. South: BY, BW, SL.
data_description.pellet_quantity: 3 t is only published per region.

gas.title: Natural gas
gas.description: Eurostat publishes household gas prices twice a year. The integration carries the latest value forward with the monthly gas price index, so the current value is an estimate.

settings.title: Heating prices options
settings.description: Enter what you pay to compare it with the market price. With your fuel and yearly consumption, the integration also calculates your heating costs per year for every fuel.

data_description.annual_consumption: Heating oil in litres, wood pellets in tonnes, natural gas in kWh.

purchases.title: Last purchase
purchases.description: Enter what you last bought and what you paid in total, to compare it with today's price. Fill in all three values for a fuel or leave them empty.

natural_gas.description: Natural gas is not filled up, so use your last bill.

lpg.name: LPG
lpg.description: The official price is for motor fuel. Your price is therefore carried forward with its trend since the purchase, which makes today's cost an estimate.
